messages:
frank: heads-up 1 1  embedding docs lint failing on staging. batch embeddings example still shows a bare array-of-vectors response, but OpenAPI now defines `results` as an array of objects with `id`, `embedding`, and optional `metadata`. failing example: 

```json
[
  [0.12, -0.04, ...],
  [0.03, 0.88, ...]
]
```

nina: thanks. yep that used to be the shape when we only returned embeddings. we added `id` to make it stable for batching + metadata. docs should show canonical response and a tiny migration snippet.

oliver: suggested replacement response example:

```json
{
  "model": "open-sim-embed-v1",
  "results": [
    {"id": "0", "embedding": [0.12, -0.04, ...], "metadata": {"source": "doc1"}},
    {"id": "1", "embedding": [0.03, 0.88, ...]}
  ]
}
```

frank: also update SDK snippets: Python example currently does `resp = client.embeddings(["a","b"])` then uses `resp[0]` which will break. change to `resp.results[0].embedding` (or SDK helpers if available). add a one-line migration note showing how to map the old array to the new shape for quick compatibility: `embeddings = [r["embedding"] for r in resp["results"]]`.

ci-bot: docs linter error: docs/embeddings.md: example-schema-mismatch (line 102).

nina: i'm opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921  that updates JSON examples, adjusts Python/JS/Go snippets, and adds a short migration appendix called "Batch embeddings response changes". also added an examples fixture test.

oliver: added a small helper snippet in JS: `const vectors = response.results.map(r => r.embedding);` and a note about stable ids: "ids are stringified indexes by default for compatibility".

frank: good to call out that some older SDK versions still return the raw array for tiny payloads; added a compatibility note and a link to SDK upgrade instructions.

docs-bot: PR checks: docs lint  pending, schema tests  pending.

ci-bot: PR checks: docs lint \u2705, schema tests \u2705, staging build \u2705.

nina: merged. added changelog bullet and a short sentence in the API migration guide.

frank: thanks team. one small win 1
